notes: After a strong start (Siphon, Inside Job steal) the Runner clicked for credits for about 17 turns, hoarding 78 credits without installing or running. The Corp scored four agendas over several turns each without ever being contested.
Solid scoring plan behind Mlinzi with strong economy. Spent a few early turns clicking for credits at 14-20 credits and discarding at end of turn instead of developing the board.

Pressured open HQ well early but never checked the naked remote, then clicked for credits for four turns with 13-29 credits. Late on it ran the same server four times in one turn to see the same Jeeves, which burned its money right before the Corp's final score.

Left HQ open for five turns, and a GFI behind a single Enigma got stolen even though the Corp had 15 credits and ice in hand. Later it clicked for credits at 30-50 credits while discarding cards every turn.

Good exploitation of the unprotected R&D with Temujin and fast econ, winning on turn 8. It was slow to test the single-iced HQ even though Paperclip was installed, and it spent clicks removing tags while rich.
Won comfortably against a broke Runner but spent many turns clicking for credits and discarding a full hand. R&D stayed unprotected until turn 8.

Ran into the known, unbreakable IP Block on R&D almost every turn for 30+ turns, getting tagged and paying to clear tags each time. HQ, which Black Orchestra could break, was run only rarely, and the eventual win came from chip-damage steals rather than a plan.

With 33 credits it declined to pay 1 credit to get past Pop-up Window in front of an agenda. It then clicked for credits up to 48 while the Corp scored two GFIs behind that same ice, and its repeated same-turn R&D runs only saw the same top card.

Spent clicks and credits trashing Daily Casts and playing do-nothing operations, then sat near 0 credits for 20 turns, discarding free ice (Pop-up Window, Resistor) instead of installing it. Two agendas behind a lone Resistor were stolen, though the Corp eventually won behind Tollbooth.
Good Marilyn economy and steady scoring behind Border Control. It made odd choices, though: Audacity trashed its own hand to put an advancement on ice, and it idled with 30+ credits.
A fast, efficient rush scoring from iced remotes. It left R&D and HQ open early and drained itself to 0 credits, and one turn of credit clicks ended with three cards discarded.

Early aggression stole three agendas, but the Runner then lived on 0-3 credits and carried tags for most of the game. It also ran into Magnet with Overclock without breaking it and never checked the remote with the advanced card.

Kept installing agendas one per turn into the same remote and leaving them overnight, though Corroder had already shown it walks through the two Walls of Static and neither Data Raven nor Shadow ends the run. Four agendas were stolen in four turns.
Correctly hammered the unprotected R&D and won on turn 6, but repeated same-turn R&D runs mostly re-saw the same top card. It sat on 1 credit and ignored the Corp's advancing remotes.

Bumped into the rezzed Eli 1.0 on R&D turn after turn without breaking it, even with Corroder installed and enough credits. It finally ran an unknown Jinteki remote with 2 cards in grip and paid to steal Fetal AI, letting PE's damage flatline it.

R&D was guarded only by Funhouse, which has no ETR, and the Corp never added ice despite 15-25 credits and repeated R&D steals that decided the game. It clicked for credits and discarded instead, and never punished the Runner's large pile of tags.

Never contested the scoring remote while the Corp advanced two Obokatas and Longevity Serum over multiple turns. It hoarded 47 credits with an empty grip and ran Archives repeatedly, and twice ran into the known Anansi with no plan, losing its grip and Engolo.

Advanced Elective Upgrade behind a lone Vanilla and left it overnight to be stolen, and HQ (flooded after Ultraviolet Clearance, guarded only by Vanilla) lost Vitruvius. It wasted Biotic Labor's clicks and discarded 2-4 cards per turn, ending broke.

Sensible Jinteki trap and remote play (Snare, Pup, Katana, Fetal AI) eventually closed the game. However, it sat at 0-4 credits all game, and HQ behind a single Enigma leaked Gila Hands and House of Knives.

Ran the open R&D four times a turn, re-seeing the same top card, while sitting on 0-2 credits and building no economy. Once IP Block was rezzed it ran into it 18 times, getting tagged each time, while the Corp scored three agendas from one remote.
